gap

The gap property sets the space between rows and columns in grid, flex, and multi-column layouts. It is a shorthand for row-gap and column-gap.

Syntax

gap: 1rem;
gap: 1rem 2rem;
gap: calc(1rem + 2px);

Values

<length>
A fixed size, such as 16px or 1rem. Negative values are invalid.
<percentage>
Relative to the size of the container along the relevant axis.
normal
The browser default: 1em for multi-column layout, 0 elsewhere.

Keywords

Only normal is a keyword. Earlier drafts also allowed auto, which was removed.

Lengths

UnitRelative toExample
pxnothinggap: 8px
remthe root font sizegap: 0.5rem
%the containergap: 5%

Examples

A two-column grid with a 1rem gap:

.grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 1rem; }

Use gap instead of margins on grid items; it does not add space at the edges.
